Coquitlam houses by price band, October 2026

54 houses sold in October against 378 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,500,001 to $1,750,000, with 15 sold (28% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 at 36%.

Duplexes and half duplexes in Coquitlam
What a duplex looks like in Coquitlam

items.t: The usual duplex form: Coquitlam's duplex form class is the individual duplex building on a single lot, in the forms the City's small-scale residential framework names — the City's guide describes four small-scale residential zones (R-1 through R-4) in its Zoning Bylaw, with forms including secondary suites, laneway homes, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes. A specific duplex is verified on its title (one lot, strata plan, or subdivided pair).

faq.q: Can I buy just one side of a duplex somewhere in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Only if that side is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot from a subdivision. Check the title first.

faq.q: How many homes can a Coquitlam single-family lot hold?
faq.a: Up to four dwelling units in low-density neighbourhoods under the City's small-scale residential zones — 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m² and 4 units on lots 280 m² or larger in the R-1/R-2 zones, in forms including suites, laneway homes, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes, subject to property-specific eligibility.

Eagle Ridge Hospital at 475 Guildford Way in Port Moody, on the Port Moody/Coquitlam border, with a 24-hour emergency department and acute, ambulatory and long-term care programs; the region's major tertiary hospital is Royal Columbian in New Westminster.

faq.q: When are property taxes due in Coquitlam?
faq.a: For 2026, City of Coquitlam property taxes were due July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to unpaid current taxes after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% after September 15, 2026, including unclaimed Home Owner Grants.
